definitions.gloss: shudder; shiver; trembling with fear or horror
definitions.explanation: An involuntary physical trembling caused by intense fear, horror, or shock. Used for situations that inspire deep dread.

examples.japanese: {戦慄|せんりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{戦慄|せんりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: I felt a shudder at the sight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}って→知る：00458_shiru⟧、⟦{背筋|せすじ}→背筋：13931_sesuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{戦慄|せんりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: When I learned the truth of the incident, a shiver ran down my spine.

notes:
USAGE:
{戦慄|せんりつ} is a literary and dramatic word. In everyday speech, people are more likely to say ⟦{身震|みぶる}い→身震い：14288_miburui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to shudder) or ⟦ぞっと→ぞっと：05272_zotto⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be horrified). {戦慄|せんりつ} appears frequently in news, literature, and dramatic contexts.
Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{旋律|せんりつ}→旋律：04753_senritsu⟧ (melody).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦慄|せんりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (a shudder runs through one)
- {戦慄|せんりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (to feel a shudder)
- {戦慄|せんりつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to shudder, to tremble)
- {戦慄|せんりつ}すべき (horrifying, shudder-inducing)
